name: std-learn-param-explorer
description: Generic parameter-explorer engine — two sliders drive a config-selected curve family (power y = A·xᴮ, linear y = A + B·x, or sine y = A·sin(B·x)) sampled onto a math-canvas, with a live readout of both parameters and the curve's value at the midpoint x. Subject atoms narrow the curve family and parameter labels through config; this atom owns only the sample-and-recompute mechanics. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

emits.description: The two parameter values after a slider change — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: parameter explorer, curve family, power law, linear function, sine wave

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Set Param A
events.description: Learner dragged the first parameter's slider — value is the new A; the curve recomputes immediately.

events.name: Set Param B
events.description: Learner dragged the second parameter's slider — value is the new B; the curve recomputes immediately.

events.name: Params Changed
events.description: The two parameter values after a slider change — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
